title: A1 calibration slice — first 20 reviewed entries
description: A practical 20-entry slice used to calibrate curriculum, bilingual review, pronunciation review and held-out assessment before scaling editorial sign-off.

units.title: Identify yourself and things
units.goal: Make the smallest useful identity sentences and introduce a thing.

entries.objective: Refer to yourself as the speaker.
Address the listener directly.
Build basic identity and description statements.
Introduce one non-specific countable thing.
Refer to a known or specific thing.

units.title: Possess and point
units.goal: Say what belongs to you or the listener and identify nearby/farther things.

entries.objective: Mark something as belonging to the speaker.
Mark something as belonging to the listener.
Express basic possession.
Point to or identify a nearby singular thing.
Point to or identify a farther singular thing.

units.title: Talk about people together
units.goal: Refer to other people and combine simple ideas.

entries.objective: Refer to one male person already identified.
Refer to one female person already identified.
Refer to the speaker together with other people.
Refer to people or things as a group.
Join two people, things or simple ideas.

units.title: Ask basic questions and express ability
units.goal: Ask who/what/where/how and say what someone can do.

entries.objective: Ask for the identity or nature of a thing.
Ask for the identity of a person.
Ask about a basic location.
Ask about manner or condition in a basic exchange.
Express and ask about basic ability.
